overview: The original factsheet lists 348 homes: 83 studios, 126 one-, 111 two- and 28 three-bedroom apartments. This is a document inventory, not a live availability count.
research.priceNote: Current developer headline: AED 549,000. The original factsheet starts at AED 525,000; Property Finder quotes an AED 582,000 launch reference. Confirm a specific available unit.
research.paymentNote: PDC schedule shown. Non-PDC: 20% booking, 35 monthly 1% payments, the same three milestone payments, then 50 monthly 0.5% payments. Both total 100%; contractual eligibility and handover triggers need confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Current developer FAQ forecasts Q3 2027; Property Finder lists June 2026. Neither establishes actual completion.
